_doc: Approved waivers for scripts/check-advisories.py. Empty is the normal state.
One entry waives one advisory for one package, and nothing else. Every field is required:
advisory     the id the check prints (GHSA-..., RUSTSEC-...)
reason       why the shipped product is not exposed, or what replaces the fix
expires      YYYY-MM-DD; after it the check fails again, so a waiver is reviewed rather than forgotten
A waived advisory is still printed, with its approval. An entry that matches nothing is reported for removal.
